text:
Jordan: quick design sync - thinking about a less heavy 'pause' affordance for streaming. users want to stop long answers but keep context for a retry.
Maya P: yep. do we mean Pause (resume possible) vs Interrupt (stop and keep partial) vs Cancel (discard)?
Jordan: exactly. my proposal: 3 states exposed via a compact menu on the message bubble: Resume, Interrupt (preserve), Discard. default action key = Interrupt.
Samir: runtime already supports partial results + resume token in some models. resume is harder because we need to stitch cache. we can do Interrupt (early-stop) now and show a local "resume" placeholder that triggers a regen with the partial text as system prompt.
Priya (design): UI idea: tiny pill on the right of bubble with icon + label that toggles between ▌▌ (pause), ⏹ (interrupt), and ✖ (discard). hover shows action text. keep pill 32px for touch.
Maya P: microcopy: prefer verbs. labels: "Pause stream", "Keep partial", "Discard draft". thoughts?
Jordan: love verb-first. also show an inline token-estimate under the regen action: "~120 tokens to finish" (estimate computed from model avg token length). helps users decide to wait vs interrupt.
Samir: we can estimate remaining tokens by using sequence length target or length predictor; it's an approximation but fine. we'll add a field in final event: `remaining_tokens_estimate": 120` (frontend-only surface).
a11y-bot: Accessibility notes: 1) expose the pill as a single accessible button with ARIA-expanded=false when not streaming. 2) provide `aria-live="polite"` updates for token estimate changes. 3) ensure color contrast of icons >= 4.5:1.
Priya (design): for mobile the pill should be hidden behind the composer overflow menu. also new "retry inline" UX: show a small inline edit area below the partial output with a green "Retry" action that preserves prompt + edits.
Maya P: copy for Retry tooltip: "Retry from this point (edits preserved)". also add a confirmation toast when discarding: "Draft discarded" with undo x3s.
Samir: dev note: stream event additions: `stream_state: active|paused|interrupted|finished`, `remaining_tokens_estimate` int, `partial_resume_token` string (optional). pause/resume will be client-only until we have kernel support.
Jordan: token counter changes: collapse token counter into a compact mode while streaming showing "used / est" (e.g., "42 / ~162") and on hover show a sparkline of tokens/sec. keep it low-contrast to avoid attention grab.
Priya (design): add reduced-motion variants: no pulsing on the pill, no sparkline anim. keyboard: map Pause to `Ctrl+\` (configurable) and Interrupt to `Esc` (playground default). announce shortcuts in the help overlay.
Maya P: let's test labels with 8 engineers before shipping. also ensure translations for verb-first copy.
Samir: will add feature flag `playground_stream_controls_v2` and a small API flag `client_resume_supported: false` initially.
Jordan: next steps - Priya to attach annotated frames, Maya to run microcopy quick check, Samir to wire feature flag + payload fields, run a11y pass. target: sandbox rollout next week.
deploy-bot: sandbox build 2026-04-02T09:12:07 deployed (featureflag: playground_stream_controls_v2).
